description: Compare two open views of the same width, height and channel count, pixel by pixel, over the whole image or a rectangle. Per channel: maximum, mean and 99th-percentile absolute difference, and the fraction of samples outside [0, 1] in each view. "identical" is true when every absolute difference is 0. The 99th percentile is taken over at most 2,000,000 evenly spaced samples (p99Samples says how many); maximum and mean use every sample. Neither view is changed.

rect.description: Optional region [x0, y0, x1, y1] in pixels, x1/y1 exclusive

name: compare_images
